### Added

- Workflow packages can receive signed live updates with Pinned or Automatic policies; updates needing setup keep the current workflow usable until setup is complete. Workflows settings exposes publisher review, policy controls, release notes and applied update history.
- App startup preserves pre-migration database checkpoints across failed upgrades and retries, and offers Retry Startup while retaining credential-key protections.
- Workflow authors can create change fragments and prepare reviewed release notes and version plans with the Bun release utility.

### Changed

- Workflow submissions receive a retryable update-pending response while an app restart waits for accepted workflows and package installs to finish.

### Fixed

- Active workflows keep their settings and credentials during updates or removal; unused data is cleaned up when they finish.
